name: 30x30 Southeast Asia Ocean Fund open call
summary: Multi-year awards for creating, expanding and effectively managing marine protected and conserved areas in Southeast Asia, led by in-region NGOs and community groups. Expressions of interest are taken at any time and reviewed in cohorts.

amount.note: Per award, distributed over multiple years

calls.label: Expression of interest (rolling, reviewed in cohorts)

status.quote: Interested organisations can submit an Expression of Interest to team@30x30fund.org at any time.

applicant_types.quote: Eligible organisations: NGOs (including iNGOs with in-country offices but where feasible, iNGOs are encouraged to invite their local partners to submit the application directly), Research Institutions, Civil Society Organisations.

geography.quote: dedicated to supporting efforts to protect 30% of Southeast Asia's seas by 2030.

access.quote: Shortlisted applicants will be invited to submit a Full Proposal.

window.quote: Interested organisations can submit an Expression of Interest to team@30x30fund.org at any time.

amount.quote: Each grant award may be up to USD 250,000, distributed over multiple years.
